subject: Access evidence request — SSO/SCIM samples and least-privilege mapping (Medicover SIG)
messages:
From: Alice Zhou <alice.zhou@medicover.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@medicover.com
Date: Fri, 22 Jun 2028 16:14:00 +0200
Subject: SIG evidence — SSO/SCIM samples and least-privilege mapping

Hi Markus / Ben,

Thanks again for the demo last week. As part of our SIG intake we need to collect a small set of IAM artifacts to close the Access Control section. Can you provide the following by next Thursday (2028-06-29)?

- SSO/SAML: example SAML assertion (redacted) and an IdP metadata snapshot
- SCIM: a sample SCIM delta export for a 7-day window (CSV or JSON) showing attribute mappings for new hires and deprovisions
- RBAC / least-privilege: export of role definitions + an example role-to-user mapping for a customer tenant (anonymized)
- Short narrative (1 page) describing how role owners are assigned and how role changes are audited

Attachments: I’ve attached our updated SIG questionnaire (Medicover_SIG_questionnaire_v2.pdf) and a template CSV for SCIM samples. If you’d prefer, we can accept a shared Drive link.

A couple of clarifying notes: the auditor may ask for timestamps and change histories for SCIM events; if you cannot produce full timestamps for service accounts we can note that in the response. Also, please mark any artifacts that are PII-sensitive so our security team can redact.

Who at Redwood will be the primary contact for evidence delivery (and for any quick follow-ups from our auditor)?

Best,
Alice
Alice Zhou
IT Risk & Compliance — Medicover Health
security@medicover.com
[Attachment: Medicover_SIG_questionnaire_v2.pdf]

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Zhou <alice.zhou@medicover.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 22 Jun 2028 17:02:00 +0200
Subject: Re: SIG evidence — SSO/SCIM samples and least-privilege mapping

Hi Alice —

Thanks for the clear list and the questionnaire. We can provide the artifacts you requested; tentative delivery plan below:

- SAML assertion + IdP metadata snapshot: we will produce a redacted assertion and current metadata file (expected 2 business days).
- SCIM delta export: Ben will run a 7-day delta from our staging tenant and scrub PII; we will deliver as CSV. Note that service-account-triggered events have abbreviated timestamps in our current pipeline (we document this in the narrative).
- RBAC export & mapping: we’ll produce role definitions and an anonymized role->user mapping for a representative tenant; we’ll also include the role owner roster.
- 1-page narrative: I’ll draft this and include the audit cadence and owner-change workflow.

A couple of asks for Medicover (to speed reviewer acceptance):
1) Do you need raw assertion traces (AuthnRequest/Response) or is a single representative SAML response sufficient?
2) For the RBAC mapping, would it be acceptable to replace email addresses with stable pseudo-identifiers (e.g., user_001) or do you need hashed emails?

We’ll upload the package to the Drive link you shared (or send to your security mailbox) and mark any high-sensitivity fields for redaction. I’ve cc’d Irene (Security Engineering) and Ben (Customer Ops) — they will handle the SCIM extract and role mapping.

Markus Klein
Head of Trust & Security — Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwood.ai

Markus / Irene — quick status update:

- I pulled the SCIM delta from staging (2028-06-15 -> 2028-06-21), scrubbed emails, and saved as scim-delta-sample.csv (attached). The extract includes create/update/delete events and the attribute map.
